title: Multifunctional roles and advances of polymers in solar cell technologies: a review
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35998-36049

Nouf K. Al-Saleem, Aishah Al-Naghmaish, Mohamed Madani, Wadiah Alfawwar, A. M. Elbasiony, Salha Alharthi, Md Azizul Haque, Mohamed Mohamady Ghobashy
Polymers enable flexible, lightweight solar cells with >18% efficiency. Encapsulants boost UV and moisture resistance. Self-cleaning coatings retain 95% output, and stretchable polymers allow wearable modules with up to 50% strain.
